Remark
[Simplicity of $\lambda _1$ and Rayleigh's formula] ↗ thm:variational-principle-principal-eigenvalue 1. ch6:6.5-rem-2\group Eigenvalues

(i) The principal eigenvalue is simple, and \[ 0 < \lambda _1 < \lambda _2 \leq \lambda _3 \leq \cdots . \]

(ii) The equivalent Rayleigh formula is \[ \lambda _1 = \min _{\substack {u \in H_0^1(U) \\ u \neq 0}} \frac{B[u,u]}{\| u\| _{L^2(U)}^2}. \]
